PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, DECEMBER 18, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Kevin Scott, President  Gina Maguire, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Vice President  Al Austin II, Commissioner
Charles Parkin, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  COMMISSION@LBUTILITIES.ORG

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  25-57235  Recommendation to approve December 4, 2025 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-57236  Recommendation to approve Retirement Order Nos. 6193 and 6194 for items that
  have become obsolete or unrepairable during the current year.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

REGULAR AGENDA

3.  25-57237  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal for the LB-5 Rehabilitation Project
  (EO-3772), award a contract to DRP Engineering Inc., in an amount not to exceed
  $314,701 for a period of two years, and authorize the General Manager to execute
  all documents necessary to enter into the contract, including any necessary
  subsequent amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-57238  Recommendation to adopt Specifications No. WD-13-23 for the Water Main Bridge
  Crossings Repair Project Sites No. 2, No. 3, and No. 28 (MO-3831), award a
  contract to Capital Industrial Coatings, LLC, in the amount not to exceed
  $2,159,263.50, and authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to enter into the contract, including any necessary subsequent
  amendments.

  Page 1 of 4
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, DECEMBER 18, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-57239  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proprosal for Construction Management
  and Inspection Services for the Water Main Bridge Crossings Repair Project Sites
  No. 2, No. 3, and No. 28 (MO-3831) and award contract Harper & Associates
  Engineering, Inc. for a total amount not to exceed $249,575, for a period of two
  years; and authorize the General Manager to execute all documents necessary to
  enter into the contract, including any necessary subsequent amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-57240  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal for Engineering Design Services
  for the Rancho Los Alamitos Transmission Main Improvement Project (MC-5264),
  award a contract to AtkinsRéalis USA Inc. in the amount not to exceed $252,040
  for a period of two years, and authorize the General Manager to execute all
  documents necessary to enter into the contract, including any necessary
  subsequent amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  25-57241  Recommendation to receive and file the Long Beach Public Utilities Department’s
  protest to Application 25-09-014, which was submitted by the Southern California
  Gas Company and San Diego Gas & Electric Company to the California Public
  Utilities Commission for authority to revise natural gas rates and implement
  storage proposals effective January 1, 2027.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  25-57243  Recommendation to receive and file the December 4, 2025 Planning Committee
  Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  25-57245  Recommendation to receive and file the General Manager’s Monthly Report for
  November 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

CLOSED SESSION

25-57246  Pending Litigation – closed session conference with legal counsel relating to liability
  claims pursuant to subparagraph (2) of subdivision (d) of Section 54956.9 of the
  California Government Code: Government Tort Claim of Rancho Los Alamitos
  Foundation (C25-0268).

  Page 2 of 4
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, DECEMBER 18, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

25-57284  Pursuant to Paragraph (b) (1) of Section 54957 of the California Government Code
  regarding Public Employee Performance Evaluation: General Manager

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Board.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Dynna Long, Executive Assistant to the Board, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72
hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, or if you need the agenda provided in an alternate format, please call the Board
of Public Utilities Commissioners Executive Assistant at (562) 570-2435 or (562) 570-6626
(telecommunications for the deaf) by 12 noon, the day prior to the meeting.
